question: Should OpenClaw adopt memory role slots as the core config/runtime contract for composing recall, capture, compaction, dreaming, and user-model memory providers?
rationale: This is a public plugin-slot/config architecture change with migration and per-agent semantics, so automation cannot decide the permanent API shape without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt role slots through the linked PR
options.body: Review the open implementation as the canonical path and require compatibility, doctor, docs, and live upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to specific coexistence fixes
options.body: Reject broad role slots for now and instead track smaller fixes such as dreaming coexisting with external recall providers.

options.title: Defer to plugin ecosystem design
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a separate plugin API RFC before changing core slot semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt role slots through the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review the open implementation as the canonical path and require compatibility, doctor, docs, and live upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active implementation candidate and have already mapped the concrete config/runtime surfaces for review.
